svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D 4-core @ 2.4 GHz (Standard) or 8-core @ 1.9 GHz (Premium)
svg.data-memory: 2x 16 GB DDR4 SO-DIMM with ECC (Standard) or 2x 32 GB (Premium)
svg.data-storage: 1x 160 GB SSD (Standard) or 2x 160 GB SSD with VROC RAID (Premium)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR/ER; 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER; 1G SFP SX/LX (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
svg.data-transceivers-sfp56: 50G SFP56 SR/LR/ER (datasheet compatible transceiver list). Recorded under this key rather than the house `optics-sfp56` because `sfp56` is not yet one of the pluggable-cage media tokens the L40 harvest recognises, and an `optics-` key that joins to no group is worse than one filed plainly
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/FR4/SR8/DR4/DR4+; 100G QSFP-DD ZR+/DR4/LR4; 100G QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/LR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
svg.data-coherent: the platform is optimised for 400ZR and OpenZR+ coherent optics for direct metro aggregation without external transponders (datasheet Key Benefits); which of the six QSFP-DD ports accept them is not stated
svg.data-tsn: Time Sensitive Networking for low packet loss and low delay variation
svg.data-gnss: internal GNSS receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-cable: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-timing: GNSS SMA, 1PPS and 10MHz SMB and a ToD RJ45, each input/output; SyncE and IEEE 1588v2 with the Default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1 and G.8275.2 profiles, T-TC, T-BC/OC and T-GM, Class C accuracy
svg.data-console: RJ45 serial console (datasheet port list; not on the front face)
svg.data-oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M (datasheet port list; not on the front face)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A
